highlights: Backup walkers saved 31 walks that would have been cancelled, and no owner was left waiting.
Two weekends of dog-park pop-ups brought in 38 new owners at no paid cost.
Finished the seed deck and the 36-month model, and booked the first investor calls.
lowlights: Walker cancellations are down to 2.4%, still above our 2% goal.
Card fees on small tips cost more than we planned. We now round tips into one weekly payout.
asks: Intros to property managers of dog-friendly apartment buildings in Austin.
A senior engineer who has built a two-sided marketplace.
Seed investors who back consumer marketplaces: we are raising $1.5M.
